scope: the combinations that run together on the target module: perception plus navigation plus motion plus dashboard
why_estimate: No capture exists from a real module. Every ceiling below is derived from a documented component figure or a measured local baseline, and none of them is a measurement of the target. BSP-PERF-001 stays NOT_EXECUTED until a capture is registered.

memory_ceiling_kb.basis: 8 GiB module minus the reserved carveout the JetPack L4T layout documents; the ceiling is the usable software budget, not the module size.

temperature_ceiling_c.basis: The module thermal spec upper bound; a sustained run above this is throttling rather than computing.

throttling_counter_ceiling.basis: A sustained workload in the target power mode should not throttle. A non-zero count means the power mode is wrong or the workload is out of scope for this module.

cpu_peak_percent_ceiling.basis: Leaves headroom for the control loop, which must not queue behind perception.

power_mode.value: the mode recorded in the capture
power_mode.basis: Not chosen here: the power mode is a product decision and the capture records which one applied.

claims: a budget with every number marked ESTIMATE
NOT a measurement of the target module
